00187                 case 1: /* Binary format */

00291 int mesh_gen_init_simp( mesh_t *mesh_in, long int nidx_in )
00292 {
00293         long int i,j,k,itmp;
00294         long int dim = mesh_in->dim;
00295         long int indx[mesh_in->nvert];  /* Contains the indices of the dim closest nodes */
00296         long int ptr[dim+1];
00297         double dist[mesh_in->nvert];    /* Contains the distance of mesh_in->vertx[clos[dim]] from nidx_in */
00298         double dtmp;
00299         int fnd,csp;
00300         for(i=0;i<mesh_in->nvert;i++)
00301         {
00302                 dist[i] = 0.0;
00303                 for(j=0;j<dim;j++)
00304                         dist[i] += pow( mesh_in->vertx[i*dim+j] - mesh_in->vertx[nidx_in*dim+j], 2.0 );
00305                 indx[i] = i;
00306         }
00307         for(i=mesh_in->nvert-1;i>=0;i--)
00308         {
00309                 for(j=0;j<i;j++)
00310                 {
00311                         if( dist[j] > dist[j+1] )
00312                         {
00313                                 dtmp = dist[j];
00314                                 itmp = indx[j];
00315                                 dist[j] = dist[j+1];
00316                                 indx[j] = indx[j+1];
00317                                 dist[j+1] = dtmp;
00318                                 indx[j+1] = itmp;
00319                         }
00320                 }
00321         }
00322 
00323         /* Now get the final node which is above the plane mesh_in->simpx[0:2] and which has no node in circumsphere */
00324         csp = 0;
00325         for(i=0;i<mesh_in->nvert;i++)
00326         {
00327                 if( std::find( indx, indx + mesh_in->dim, i ) != indx + mesh_in->dim )
00328                         continue;
00329                 fnd = 0;
00330                 indx[mesh_in->dim] = i; // The (dim+1)th node to finish the dim-simplex
00331                 for(j=0;j<mesh_in->nvert;j++)
00332                 {
00333                         if( std::find( indx, indx + mesh_in->dim + 1, j ) != indx + mesh_in->dim + 1 )
00334                                 continue;
00335                         dtmp = mesh_vert_in_circsph_vert( mesh_in, mesh_in->vertx + j*(mesh_in->dim), indx );
00336                         if( dtmp < 0.0 )
00337                         {
00338                                 fnd = 1;
00339                                 break;
00340                         }
00341                 }
00342                 if( fnd == 0 ) // Then the simplex in indx has no other vertex inside its circumsphere
00343                 {
00344                         csp = 1;
00345                         break; // indx already contains the dim vertex ids of a simplex
00346                 }
00347         }
00348 
00349         if( csp != 1 )
00350                 return -1; // Means that could not find an initial simplex
00351 
00352         /* Add the actual simplex stored in indx */
00353         mesh_in->nsimp = 1;
00354         mesh_in->simpx = (long int*) realloc( mesh_in->simpx, ( dim + 1 ) * sizeof(long int) );
00355         for(i=0;i<dim+1;i++) // Just the first mesh_in->dim of them
00356                 mesh_in->simpx[i] = indx[i];
00357 
00358         /* Now add faces to ufaces */
00359         mesh_in->ufaces = (long int*) realloc( mesh_in->ufaces, ( dim + 1 ) * ( dim + 1 ) * sizeof(long) );
00360         combinadic_init( dim + 1, dim, ptr );
00361         for(i=0,k=dim;i<binomial(dim+1,dim);i++,k--)
00362         {
00363                 for(j=0;j<dim;j++)
00364                         mesh_in->ufaces[i*(dim+1)+j] = indx[ptr[j]];
00365                 mesh_in->ufaces[i*(dim+1)+dim] = indx[k];
00366                 ++mesh_in->nunff;
00367                 combinadic_next( dim + 1, dim, ptr );
00368         }
00369 
00370         return 0;
00371 }

00388         {
00389                 /* For coordinates 0 through i, find x such that all vertices
00390                         lie to the right of simplex (v0,...,vi) */
00391                 if( i == 0 )
00392                 {
00393                         for(j=0;j<mesh_in->nvert;j++)
00394                         {
00395                                 if( mesh_in->vertx[j*mesh_in->dim] < dmin || j == 0 )
00396                                 {
00397                                         dmin = mesh_in->vertx[j*mesh_in->dim];
00398                                         min[0] = j;
00399                                 }
00400                         }
00401                 }
00402                 else
00403                 {
00404                         /* Try to find a vertex with no nodes to its one side */
00405                         for(j=0;j<mesh_in->nvert;j++)
00406                         {
00407                                 if( simple_find_long( j, i, min ) != -1 )
00408                                         continue;
00409                                 min[i] = j;
00410                                 for(m=0;m<i+1;m++)
00411                                         for(n=0;n<i+1;n++)
00412                                                 face[m*(i+1)+n] = mesh_in->vertx[min[m]*mesh_in->dim+n];
00413                                 ck = 0;
00414                                 for(k=0;k<mesh_in->nvert;k++)
00415                                 {
00416                                         /* Make sure we don't choose anything in min again */
00417                                         if( k == j || simple_find_long( k, i, min ) != -1 )
00418                                                 continue;
00419                                         dmin = mesh_simplex_determ( i + 1, mesh_in->vertx + k * mesh_in->dim, face );
00420                                         ret = ( dmin > 0.0 ? 1 : 0 );
00421                                         if( k == 0 )
00422                                         {
00423                                                 cur = ret;
00424                                                 continue;
00425                                         }
00426                                         if( ret != cur ) /* Then you found one on the `other` side, so continue in j */
00427                                         {
00428                                                 ck = 1; /* ck = 1 => stop because j does not form a simplex */
00429                                                 break;
00430                                         }
00431                                 }
00432                                 if( ck == 0 ) /* If got through all k iteration then use j to complete the face */
00433                                         break; // Because found a vertex to the left of the face min[0],...,j; find another j
00434                         }

00440          * If cur = 1, then simplex_determ > 0.0 implies `inside`, relative to the vertex
00441          * ordering in min. So at this point we also need to do the face_parity determinant
00442          * to detect handedness of the min vertices. If face_parity > 0, then min is right-
00443          * handed (or counter-clockwise), and so this means the order is such that the normal
00444          * points inward. We wish here to order the vertices in each face so as to have an
00445          * outward normal. If change the handedness of the vertices in min, then we change
00446          * the definition of `inside` because simplex_determ needs to be < 0.0 for the vertex
00447          * to be inside, assuming that face_parity is < 0.0 instead of > 0.0. So cur and
00448          * face_parity(min) together determine the rule which defines `inside`.
00449          */
00450 
00451         /* First make sure min is listed in right-handed/counter-clockwise order relative
00452                 to the OUTSIDE, i.e. relative to the INSIDE, it should appear in left-handed/clockwise order */
00453         for(i=0;i<mesh_in->dim;i++)

00563                         }
00564                         if( ck1 == 1 )
00565                                 continue; // i is already in the set, so continue
00566                         surf = mesh_vert_surf_test_interp_vert( mesh_in, mesh_in->vertx + i * mesh_in->dim, vids );
00567                         if( surf > 1.0 )
00568                         {
00569                                 for(k=0;k<mesh_in->dim;k++)
00570                                         wids[k] = vids[k];
00571                                 wids[mesh_in->dim] = i;
00572                                 m = 0;
00573                                 for(j=0;j<mesh_in->nvert;j++)
00574                                 {
00575                                         ck1 = 0;
00576                                         for(k=0;k<mesh_in->dim+1;k++)
00577                                                 if( wids[k] == j )
00578                                         {
00579                                                 ck1 = 1;
00580                                                 break;
00581                                         }
00582                                         if( ck1 == 1 )
00583                                                 continue;
00584                                         circ = mesh_vert_in_circsph_vert( mesh_in, mesh_in->vertx + j*mesh_in->dim, wids );
00585                                         if( circ < 0.0 )
00586                                         {
00587                                                 m = 1;
00588                                                 break;
00589                                         }
00590                                 }
00591                                 if( m == 0 ) // => no node in its circumsphere
00592                                 {
00593                                         /* Then the circumsphere is empty, so add to simplices */
00594                                         p = mesh_simpx_index( mesh_in, wids );
00595                                         if( p == -1 )
00596                                                 mesh_app_simpx( mesh_in, wids );
00597                                         else
00598                                                 continue;
00599 
00600                                         /* Now check the faces other than f */
00601                                         combinadic_init( mesh_in->dim + 1, mesh_in->dim, vec );
00602                                         for(j=0,k=mesh_in->dim-1;j<binomial(mesh_in->dim+1,mesh_in->dim)-1;j++,k--)
00603                                         {
00604                                                 combinadic_next( mesh_in->dim + 1, mesh_in->dim, vec );
00605                                                 for(m=0;m<mesh_in->dim;m++)
00606                                                         xids[m] = wids[vec[m]];
00607                                                 xids[mesh_in->dim] = wids[k];
00608 
00609                                                 /* Check xids against ufaces and add accordingly */
00610                                                 p = mesh_ufaces_index( mesh_in, xids );
00611                                                 if( p == -1 )
00612                                                         mesh_app_unf_face( mesh_in, xids );
00613                                                 else
00614                                                         mesh_del_unf_face( mesh_in, p );
00615                                         }
00616                                         break;
00617                                 }
00618                         }
00619                 }
00620         }
00621 
00622         return 0;
00623 }

00651 int mesh_del_unf_face( mesh_t *mesh_in, long int idx_in )
00652 {
00653         long int i;
00654         long int idx = ( idx_in + 1 ) * ( mesh_in->dim + 1 );
00655         long int mix = mesh_in->nunff * ( mesh_in->dim + 1 );
00656         long int *ptr;
00657         if( mesh_in->nunff > 1 )
00658         {
00659                 for(i=idx;i<mix;i++)
00660                         mesh_in->ufaces[i-(mesh_in->dim+1)] = mesh_in->ufaces[i];
00661                 ptr = (long int*) realloc( mesh_in->ufaces, ( mesh_in->nunff - 1 ) * ( mesh_in->dim + 1 ) * sizeof(long int) );
00662                 if( ptr != NULL )
00663                 {
00664                         mesh_in->ufaces = ptr;
00665                         --mesh_in->nunff;
00666                 }
00667                 else
00668                         return -1;
00669         }
00670         else
00671         {
00672                 if( mesh_in->nunff == 1 )
00673                 {
00674                         free( mesh_in->ufaces );
00675                         mesh_in->ufaces = NULL; // To make sure that calling realloc next time doesn't fail miserably
00676                         --mesh_in->nunff;
00677                 }
00678                 else
00679                         return -1;
00680         }
00681         return 0;
00682 }

00831                         }

00957                 vidx[i] = mesh_in->ufaces[fid_in*(mesh_in->dim+1)+i];

00962 double mesh_vert_surf_test_interp_vert( mesh_t *mesh_in, double *vert_in, long int *vids_in )
00963 {
00964         /* Equivalent to plane_test as written previously */
00965         long int i,j,vidx;
00966         double sum;
00967         dmatrix_t mat;
00968         dvector_t vec;
00969         mat.start = (double*) malloc( ( mesh_in->dim + 1 ) * ( mesh_in->dim + 1 ) * sizeof(double) );
00970         mat.rsize = mesh_in->dim + 1;
00971         mat.nrows = mesh_in->dim + 1;
00972         mat.ncols = mesh_in->dim + 1;
00973         vec.start = (double*) malloc( ( mesh_in->dim + 1 ) * sizeof(double) );
00974         vec.rsize = 1;
00975         vec.length = mesh_in->dim + 1;
00976 
00977         for(i=0;i<mesh_in->dim+1;i++)
00978         {
00979                 vidx = vids_in[i];
00980                 mat.start[i*mat.rsize] = 1.0;
00981                 for(j=0;j<mesh_in->dim;j++)
00982                         mat.start[i*mat.rsize+j+1] = mesh_in->vertx[ mesh_in->dim * vidx + j ];
00983         }
00984         for(i=0;i<mesh_in->dim;i++)
00985                 vec.start[i*vec.rsize] = 1.0;
00986         vec.start[mesh_in->dim*vec.rsize] = 0.0;
00987         dmatrix_lu_dcmp( &mat );
00988         dmatrix_fb_sub_vrhs( &mat, &vec );
00989 
00990         /* Now calculate the interpolant's value at vert_in */
00991         sum = vec.start[0];
00992         for(i=0;i<mesh_in->dim;i++)
00993                 sum += vec.start[(i+1)*vec.rsize] * vert_in[i];
00994 
00995         free( mat.start );
00996         free( vec.start );
00997 
00998         return sum;
00999 }

01001 double mesh_face_parity( long int dim_in, double *point_in, double *face_in )

01060 double mesh_vert_in_circsph_vert( mesh_t *mesh_in, double *vert_in, long int *vids_in )
01061 {
01062         dmatrix_t mat;
01063         long int i,j;
01064         double det = 1.0;
01065         double norm;
01066         mat.start = (double*) malloc( ( mesh_in->dim + 2 ) * ( mesh_in->dim + 2 ) * sizeof(double) );
01067         mat.rsize = mesh_in->dim + 2;
01068         mat.nrows = mesh_in->dim + 2;
01069         mat.ncols = mesh_in->dim + 2;
01070 
01071         /* Insert the `one's into the rightmost column */
01072         for(i=0;i<mesh_in->dim+2;i++)
01073                 mat.start[i*mat.rsize+mesh_in->dim+1] = 1.0;
01074 
01075         /* First line: vert_in data */
01076         mat.start[0] = 0.0;
01077         for(j=1;j<mesh_in->dim+1;j++)
01078         {
01079                 mat.start[j] = vert_in[j-1];
01080                 mat.start[0] += vert_in[j-1] * vert_in[j-1];
01081         }
01082 
01083         for(i=1;i<mesh_in->dim+2;i++)
01084         {
01085                 mat.start[i*(mesh_in->dim+2)] = 0.0;
01086                 for(j=1;j<mesh_in->dim+1;j++)
01087                 {
01088                         mat.start[i*(mesh_in->dim+2)] += mesh_in->vertx[vids_in[i-1]*mesh_in->dim+j-1] * mesh_in->vertx[vids_in[i-1]*mesh_in->dim+j-1];
01089                         mat.start[i*(mesh_in->dim+2)+j] = mesh_in->vertx[vids_in[i-1]*mesh_in->dim+j-1];
01090                 }
01091         }
01092 
01093         dmatrix_lu_dcmp( &mat );
01094 
01095         for(i=0;i<mesh_in->dim+2;i++)
01096                 det *= mat.start[i*(mesh_in->dim+2)+i];
01097 
01098         free( mat.start );
01099         return det;
